prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 33 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1085; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with immediate complaints of neck and low back pain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the force of the impact is in keeping with soft tissue strain of the cervical and lumbar regions. Over the course of care the patient attended 33 visits. Initial treatment focused on conservative management, including manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program. Over time, additional services were added in the following months, and visit frequency and the scope of care extended beyond what is typically required for a strain of this kind. Examination findings include reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal tenderness, which support the reported injury, while neurological screening and several orthopedic tests were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the neck or low back is known to this provider. Billing records reviewed for this summary show no duplicate or repeated charges. Prognosis is fair with continued home exercise and reassessment as needed.
